sentence: The government announced a new policy to tackle unemployment
hint: Subject + past verb + object + to + infinitive
explanation: 'Tackle unemployment' significa abordar el problema del desempleo.

sentence: Voter turnout was lower than expected in this year's election
explanation: 'Turnout' se refiere al número de personas que participan en una votación.

sentence: The opposition party strongly criticised the proposed reforms
explanation: 'Opposition party' es el partido que se opone al gobierno actual.

sentence: Citizens have the right to protest peacefully against injustice
explanation: 'Have the right to' expresa un derecho legal o moral.

sentence: The minister resigned after the scandal was made public
Inequality has widened significantly over the past decade
hint: Present perfect + adverb + over + time period
explanation: 'Widen' significa ampliarse o aumentar una brecha.

sentence: The referendum result divided public opinion sharply
explanation: 'Divide opinion' significa causar desacuerdo entre la gente.

sentence: Campaigners are calling for greater transparency in public spending
explanation: 'Call for' significa exigir o pedir públicamente algo.

sentence: The new law was passed despite fierce opposition in parliament
explanation: 'Despite' va seguido de un sustantivo, no de una cláusula completa.

sentence: Were the economy to improve, support for the government would rise
explanation: 'Were + sujeto + to + infinitivo' es una condicional formal e hipotética.
